# Unblock-ZbxUser

## SYNOPSIS

Unblocks users locked out after failed logins.

## SYNTAX

```
Unblock-ZbxUser [-InputObject] <ZabbixReference<ZabbixUser>[]> [-PassThru] [-Connection <ZabbixConnection>] [-WhatIf] [-Confirm] [<CommonParameters>]
```

## DESCRIPTION

The Unblock-ZbxUser cmdlet clears the failed login count of the users given to -InputObject (names, ids or piped users) with user.unblock, so a user the frontend blocked after too many failed attempts can log in again at once. Every user the pipeline brings is unblocked in one call. The command writes the users only with -PassThru, and -WhatIf shows what it would change.

## EXAMPLES

### Example 1: Unblock a user

```powershell
Unblock-ZbxUser -InputObject 'jdoe' -PassThru | Select-Object Username, AttemptFailed
```

AttemptFailed is the user's failed login count; after the unblock it is 0.

### Example 2: Unblock every user with failed logins

```powershell
Get-ZbxUser | Where-Object AttemptFailed -GT 0 | Unblock-ZbxUser
```

Get-ZbxUser writes every user; Where-Object keeps those with failed attempts.
